description: Source file for ANGLE project that handles querying and translating GL image formats to D3D11 formats, including support checks, format size info, and vertex format info for different feature levels.

classes.name: DXGIFormatSize
classes.description: Structure holding size info for a DXGI format, including pixel bytes, block width, and block height.

classes.name: VertexFormat
classes.description: Structure describing vertex format conversion type, native DXGI format, and copy function.

methods.name: SupportsMipGen
methods.description: Checks if a DXGI format supports mipmap auto-generation at a given feature level.

methods.name: GetDXGIFormatSizeInfo
methods.description: Returns size information for a given DXGI format.

methods.name: GetVertexFormatInfo
methods.description: Retrieves vertex format info based on format ID and feature level.

methods.name: GetVertexFormatInfo_FL_9_3
methods.description: Provides vertex format info specific to D3D11 feature level 9_3.
